mechanism: Duloxetine inhibits CYP1A2 and CYP2D6 while modafinil induces CYP3A4; combined effects on serotonergic neurotransmission and CNS stimulation with potential for increased duloxetine levels.
action: Monitor for serotonin syndrome symptoms, excessive CNS stimulation, and duloxetine efficacy; consider dose adjustment if needed and counsel on symptom recognition.
